# Research Title

## Scope and authority

Research supplies evidence and recommendations, not accepted architecture or
production qualification. Name the observation date and owning decisions.

## Evidence and lessons

Record primary sources, exact revisions where available, observed behavior,
current or historical status, limitations, and applicability to a concrete owner.
Separate source facts, reported incidents, inference, and tested results.

## Open questions and validation

State unresolved choices and the scenarios needed to test the recommendation.
Link the owning open decision instead of selecting implementation implicitly.
